basis: Actual support timeout and an observed Windows launcher/child distinction justify execution-capacity work. There is no completed diagnostic evidence to justify changing the policy, representation or training objective.
scope: Separate module and new output; small deterministic historical sample only; split support construction, scoring and global aggregation; real owned Windows tree lifecycle regression. No full diagnostic run in this capacity stage.

budgets.selection: 按原registration seed顺序，在每个train/validation seed的v1对手、seat0文件组只取最前128个完整且对齐的原始行；共10个源文件组。前缀以外不解码、不为寻找特殊行扫描全文件；压缩文件散列核验与解码行量分别记账。
budgets.cap_behavior: 预定完整样本若超过候选上限即停止该基准并报告容量不足，不能截断单行候选或临时改样本以获得通过。
budgets.evaluation_accounting: 上限跨开发与正式容量验收累计；包括旧纯函数参考、新分片路径及验收复核。只调用冻结TaskNetwork.score，不调用JointAgent影子策略，不隐匿缓存命中与未命中的实际调用数。
budgets.support_boundary: 只形成明确标为sample_only的样本train索引，不得冒称完整训练支持；validation污染用合成的独有极值/类别检验。

refinements: Synthetic limits are ceilings, not targets; use the smallest fixtures proving cross-shard conflicts, complete train support and exact numeric/aggregation equivalence. Do not build a generic scheduler.

Register deterministic sample selection and resource limits before actual source decoding; share all real scoring budgets across development, reference comparison and final acceptance, including independent reproduction. Do not multiply them per reviewer.

Capacity success proves measured sample semantics and lifecycle only. Full 108310-row support, full 135406-row scoring and panel-wide costs remain unproved; record unknowns honestly and choose a separately bounded next step after review.
Machine measurements and actual PID/creation records remain local; publish only task timing, bounded aggregate resource measurements and privacy-safe closure evidence.
Preserve original failed V1 sources, incomplete result and negative policy admission permanently. Do not restart its runner or interpret a future new phase as an old success.
